hunks.new:
## Retry policy

`run_job` accepts a configurable bounded exponential retry policy. The
`max_attempts` value includes the first call. Only `RetryError::Transient`
errors are retried; `RetryError::Permanent` errors return immediately, and the
last transient error is returned when the attempt budget is exhausted.

Set `base_delay_ms` for the delay before the first retry and `max_delay_ms` for
the upper bound. Retry delays double after each transient failure and saturate
at `max_delay_ms`, including when values are large enough that doubling would
overflow. Delays are provided through the injected `Sleeper`, so callers can
supply real or test-time waiting behavior.
hunks.old:
## Status

The retry policy is not implemented yet: `run_job` performs a single
attempt and never waits. Configuration currently exposes `max_attempts`
and `base_delay_ms` only.

event.summary: Implemented configurable bounded exponential retries. RetryConfig now includes max_delay_ms; run_job retries only transient errors, returns permanent errors immediately, treats max_attempts as including the first call (with a minimum effective budget of one), injects delays through Sleeper, and saturates delay growth safely using saturating arithmetic. Added focused unit tests and public integration tests covering retries, permanent failures, attempt budgeting, zero attempts, delay bounds, and overflow-safe saturation. Updated README. Verification passed: cargo fmt --all -- --check, cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings, jobrunner.exact, and rust.workspace. Review found no issues. Modified files: README.md, src/config.rs, src/error.rs, src/lib.rs; added tests/retry_policy.rs.
